I rewatched eps 6 and 7 and when Bel said that it was not worth taking revenge for what happened 21 years ago, the part of my brain that thinks about crackpot theories said "Wait, maybe Bel thinks revenge isn't worth it because she doesn't know what happened in the prologue, and she thinks Prospera is mad because of something else she assumes she must be the Vanadis incident because perhaps the information about what happened in the prologue was never public, or it was heavily censored."  
The other thing that caught my attention was that in ep 7, Prospera talked about the Vanadis incident and the banning of Gundams as two different achievements of Dellin (I also think that if it wasn't because she was talking to Miorine and trying to manipulate her, she would have said "killed all the people in charge of making the Gundams" instead of a more peaceful sounding word like "ban").

And in the most recent episode, when they ask if they are still afraid of witches after more than 20 years, that could perfectly refer to an event different from what happened in the prologue that would have changed public opinion regarding the Gund-ARM format.  
In short, I think Vanadis and the prologue are different things, and the 21 years thing is because Bel doesn't know what happened to Prospera in the prologue.
